about: THE PRODUCER'S FUSED FORWARD (csrc/fsla/src/produce/produce.cuh), its SKELETON's budget, its store component landed (KERNEL_STANDARDS s19, s29): each component's warp instructions a CTA (a sequence's 128-token tile and a write head) at the cell, each line its trips times its trip's SASS price read from the built kernel (the lab's skeleton launch of the CTA at one CTA an SM, the innermost produce.cuh frame of each instruction), by opcode class in the price's own mix; its peak live registers; each phase's cycles a CTA. A component that lands replaces its stub's line with its own. Docs: docs/internals/produce/produce.md#budget

basis.cell: B 1, T 65,536, H_w 4, G 1, hidden 256 (4 K-steps), widths 256 and 256, d_v 64; write (entmax 1.5, softmax), read (softmax, entmax 1.5) untied: 5 jobs a write head, 20 ring stages a CTA, two masked level rows, no lo plane
basis.store_level: ~30 a call a warp (its 116 instructions: the stream, tile, scale and word addresses), 4 calls x 8 warps
basis.store_values: the growth's part: a channel a thread, 64 of 128 (~12), and its address, x 8 warps
basis.epilogue: ~15 a job a warp (the job's kind, its tied bits), 5 jobs x 8 warps
basis.load_role: the stub's ring one stage a job: 5 stages x ~24 (an EMPTY wait from the fourth on, a FULL arrival), one warp
basis.math_role: the stub's ring one stage a job: 8 warps x 5 stages x ~27 (a FULL wait's trip, the warp's sync, lane 0's arrival, the loop) and 5 jobs x 20, = 1,880
basis.tickets: one thread: the masked rows' counts (2 adds), three fences, the two tickets; the growth's copy by one CTA in 512 and the density by the last: ~150
basis.glue: ~220 a warp (the item's three divisions, 63 instructions; the shares; the barriers' init; two CTA barriers), x 9 warps
basis.zero_run: the store component's contiguous runs (built SASS): a trip is four independent 16-byte stores and their addresses and bounds, ~34 instructions (store 4, integer 26, control 4); a call's lead and tail words and bounds ~22 (integer 18, control 2, store 2). A warp: four level jobs' row tiles at 2 trips each, two masked rows' words at 1 trip: 10 trips and 6 calls, 472; x 8 warps = 3,776
basis.zero_tokens: the store component's token runs (built SASS): a trip is four tokens' stores by consecutive threads (lanes a token), ~65 instructions (store 4, integer 50, control 11); a call's one quotient (lanes, the tokens a pass) ~13 (integer 11, control 2). A warp: four level-sides' scales and the values, a trip each: 5 trips and 5 calls, 390; x 8 warps = 3,120

phase_basis: a CTA's cycles: its 5 ring stages' two edges at ~340 cycles a round trip (hold 8's traces); its outputs, 157.7 KB (the cell's 323.0 MB over its 2,048 CTAs) at HBM's write rate an SM (measure/rates.json's hbm_write, 13.21 bytes a cycle an SM) = 11,900
